meta.notes: Validates WHITEGOODS_ANALYTICS.MARTS.MART_PO_CHANGE_REQUESTS — one row per API-submitted PO change request. Table may be empty when no changes have been submitted.
Every change request must have a platform-assigned event ID.
Event IDs are UUIDs — duplicates indicate a Snowpipe double-load.
Every change request must reference a PO.
Every change request must identify the submitting supplier.
Change type must always be populated.
Change type must be one of the four recognised lifecycle values.
Platform receive timestamp must always be present (set by the Lambda).
